name: Jake English
source:
Jake English is one of the four Alpha kids. [spoiler]He is the post-scratch incarnation of Jade Harley's adoptive grandfather.[/spoiler]

He loves adventure and brawling, and speaks in a very peculiar, old-timey fashion. He has an affinity for movies, tomb-raiding, firearms, and superhero comics. Despite his love of action and outward gregariousness, he is not very assertive and extremely clueless socially. Although he touts the importance and friendship and believing in others, he is known to behave in ways that are quite self-centered, albeit unintentionally. Growing up alone in isolation on Hellmurder Island seems to be the main cause of his lack of social grace. 

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Jake_English]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
